title: Silver & Bronze Medals
description: Designed robotic systems to clean urban waste and reduce marine pollution in Busan. The solution was formally recognised by the Mayor of Busan and considered for future implementation.

title: Startup Idea Award
event: World Robot Olympiad Open Championship – Asia & Pacific
highlight: Top innovators among 70,000+ competitors from 95 nations
description: Researched and engineered a pneumatic soft robot for rescue missions and underground exploration. Bangladesh's highest honour to date in this World Robot Olympiad category.

title: Seed Fund Winner
highlight: Polluted water tested and treated in 20 coastal villages
description: Developed a modular AI device that tests water contamination instantly and cheaply, then treats it on the spot. Selected among participants from 60+ countries for a prize backed by the Swedish Government and WaterAid.

title: 3rd Prize as Mentor
description: Mentored Team MonAndo to a fully funded place in the international final with MonAndo, an AI-powered VR exposure-therapy app for underprivileged youth. Hosted by the Ministry of Education, Republic of Korea.

title: Bronze Medal as Mentor
highlight: Aerospace robotics on the global stage
description: Mentored a SAPH.Ai student to a Bronze Medal for Bangladesh with a satellite-maintenance robot that floats and works in outer space using AI computer vision.

title: National Winner
event: World Robot Olympiad Bangladesh Open Championship
highlight: Earned Bangladesh's place at WRO Asia & Pacific
description: Led Team SAPH.Ai to win the national round after first taking the winner's medal at the Dhaka Regional Round.

title: National Winner
highlight: Crowned winners of the national round
description: Won the national round with Team SAPH.Ai, recognised for exceptional technical mastery.

title: Gold Medal
highlight: Went on to represent Bangladesh in Dubai
description: Built a 6-wheel-drive AI robot that navigates dangerous sewage pipelines to find blockages, detect explosive gases like methane and clean them without risking human lives.

title: Honour of Recognition
event: Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology
highlight: Recognised by the Government of Bangladesh
description: SAPH.Ai, the robotics and AI team Abrar founded, received formal government recognition for its contributions to Bangladesh's growing tech sector.

title: 2nd Runner-Up
highlight: AI sewer robot built with OpenCV and TensorFlow
description: Designed an AI-assisted drainage and sewage robot that navigates sewers, detects debris and mitigates dangerous gases, replacing hazardous manual labour.

title: Top 20 Teams
event: BCSIR National Science and Industrial Technology Fair
highlight: Wide media coverage in the national round
description: Presented the AI-assisted drainage and sewage robot, an autonomous answer to Bangladesh's sanitation crisis and an end to hazardous manual cleaning.

title: 3rd Place & Championships as Mentor
highlight: Champions at Upazila, District and Division levels
description: Guided a SAPH.Ai student team representing Bagerhat with a disaster-response robot that crosses hazardous terrain, detects dangers and collects real-time data. They also took 3rd place at the BAFSD Science Fair.

title: Champion, IT Project Display
event: 15th DRMC National Science & Codeavour International Carnival
highlight: Champion in the IT Project Display segment
description: Exhibited the 6-wheel-drive pipeline inspection robot that finds blockages, detects methane and performs targeted cleaning underground.

title: First Position, Research Paper
highlight: Best research paper of the fest
description: The team's paper on the AI-assisted drainage and sewage robot, engineered with OpenCV and TensorFlow, took first position.

title: Champion
highlight: Hosted by the Tejgaon College Science Club
description: Presented the 6-wheel-drive pipeline inspection robot that clears blockages and detects explosive methane in underground pipelines.

title: 1st Runner-Up
highlight: Hosted by the Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman Novotheatre
description: Awarded for the AI-assisted drainage and sewage robot, a safe alternative to inhuman manual cleaning.

title: Champion, Project Display
description: Debuted the AI-assisted drainage and sewage robot, replacing dangerous manual labour with a safer, more efficient solution.
